description: A drone core reflashed into something it was never asked to be, wired to a fragment of Architect substrate and packed into a case that used to hold a glucose meter. It doesn't display anything. It gets warm, and its whine changes pitch when there's something nearby to listen to.
name: Architect signal decoder

tags.description: A drone core reflashed into something it was never asked to be, wired to a fragment of Architect substrate and packed into a case that used to hold a blood-glucose meter. It doesn't display anything. It gets warm, and the pitch of its whine changes when there's something nearby to listen to. The people who build them say a screen would only get you looked at.
